notes: Scan > Register > Fine-align to scan: pull this scan onto an earlier scan of the same place before comparing them (ICP along the surfaces, never a scale). Only the closest share of matches is fitted, so what changed is left out; scans not already close, or a fit that does not settle, are refused. The DTM is rebuilt and checked on control again; Undo puts it back. Also: Compare reads the second scan with the same coordinate setting as the open one, and the user guide has a Scan section.
